system.description: as your action, make one attack against each creature within your reach whose Level is no more than half yours. These attacks have no Advantage or Disadvantage from any source, and nothing adds an attack to them: no Press On, off-hand attack or Flowing Strikes.

activities.name: Combat Dominance
activities.text: As your action, one attack against each creature within your reach whose Level is no more than half yours (target them first). These attacks have no Advantage or Disadvantage from any source, and nothing adds an attack to them.
